name: Maria Rodrigues
bio:
Maria's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After completing her vocational training in machining, she found herself working at a small local garage that serviced rally cars on the side. The precision and problem-solving involved in keeping these machines running ignited a passion she never knew she had. She quickly became indispensable, known for her ability to diagnose and fix complex mechanical issues with minimal resources. 

Maria's approach to her role is rooted in practicality and relentless attention to detail. She believes in understanding the 'why' behind every component and process, which allows her to anticipate potential failures and optimize performance. Her experience at Crown Racing has broadened her understanding of motorsport, and she is always eager to learn and contribute to the team's success. She is particularly good at working under pressure and keeping a calm head.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: A sturdy woman with kind eyes and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of humming quietly while working on intricate parts.
Refuses to work without a strong cup of espresso nearby.
